-- Spec: shuffled returns a permutation of xs, chosen only by seed.

rand_step(state: int) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  ex rand_step(1) == rand_step(1)
  (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 3) == [1]
  ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 5)
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  var i = ys.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    state = rand_step(state)
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let tmp = ys[i]
    ys[i] = ys[j]
    ys[j] = tmp
    i -= 1
  ys
